items.title: Gucci to Present Cruise 2028 Collection in Shanghai
items.summary:
Summary 

Gucci has officially announced its Cruise 2028 runway show will take place in Shanghai on May 17The upcoming presentation marks artistic director Demna's first show in the Chinese metropolisThe event coincides with the 30th anniversary of the brand's original store opening in the region

Gucci is officially heading to China to debut its highly anticipated Cruise 2028 collection. Scheduled for May 17, the upcoming runway presentation will take place in Shanghai , marking a major milestone for the Italian luxury house as it celebrates the 30th anniversary of its very first store opening in the country.

While the event serves as artistic director Demna ’s first show in the city, Gucci is no stranger to the Chinese metropolis. The heritage brand previously hosted runway presentations in Shanghai for its Fall 2012 collection under Frida Giannini and its centenary Aria collection by Alessandro Michele in 2021. The label has also maintained a strong cultural footprint in the region through various high-profile exhibitions, including 2015's "No Longer / Not Yet," the Maurizio Cattelan-curated "The Artist Is Present" in 2018, "Gucci Cosmos" in 2023, and "Gucci Bamboo: Decoding an Icon" in 2025.

The Shanghai announcement follows Demna's massive debut Cruise collection for the house, which took over New York City's Times Square last May. Despite wider reports of a luxury slowdown in the region, major fashion houses continue to heavily invest in Chinese activations this season. Notably, Jonathan Anderson will present Dior's Cruise 2028 collection in Shanghai just days…
items.t: Gucci to Present Cruise 2028 Collection in Shanghai

items.title: Nike's 3D-Printed AIRMAX 1000 Just Got Even More Customizable With Zellerfeld
items.summary:
Summary 

Nike updates the Zellerfeld 3D-printed AIRMAX 1000 on Nike By You with embossed custom heel text.A new Lilac upper colorway joins Black and Stone, alongside seven independent Air unit colors for each shoe.Options launch November 19 on Nike's website.

Name: Nike AIRMAX 1000 By You
 Colorway: Multi-Color/Multi-Color
 SKU: JK3542-900
 MSRP: $190 USD
 Release Date: November 19
 Where to Buy: Nike 

Nike is once again pushing the boundaries of footwear customization with a major update to the AIRMAX 1000 . Following its initial October debut, the 3D-printed silhouette, developed in partnership with Zellerfeld , is rolling out with a new suite of personalization features with Nike's By You feature that leans even deeper into individual expression.

AIRMAX 1000 owners can add custom text directly onto the sneaker’s heel, positioned just above the Air unit. Rather than relying on traditional screen printing or embroidery, the personalized text is integrated directly into the shoe during the manufacturing process. Leveraging Zellerfeld’s 3D-printing technology, the wearer’s name, initials, or short message is formed as raised, embossed lettering that becomes part of the shoe’s sculpted surface.

The colors on the upper also receive a upgrade, with a fresh Lilac joining the existing Black and Stone palette. Notably, Nike now allows customers to go for asymmetrical styling by allowing wearers to choose from seven distinct Air unit colors independently for the left and right shoes. Whether it is a clean, monochromatic look, or a bold, mismatched one, the expanded palette…
items.t: Nike's 3D-Printed AIRMAX 1000 Just Got Even More Customizable With Zellerfeld

items.title: First Look at the Air Jordan 11 Low Golf "The Masters"
items.summary:
Summary 

Jordan Brand has an Air Jordan 11 Low Golf lined up for the upcoming 2027 MastersThe striking pair features a green-and-white colorway inspired directly by the Augusta National tournamentThe modified sneaker officially drops in April 2027 as part of the brand's growing fairway lineup

Jordan Brand is officially gearing up for the 2027 Masters with the introduction of the Air Jordan 11 Low Golf "The Masters." Tied directly to the iconic tournament at Augusta National, the forthcoming release serves as the latest addition to the brand's rapidly growing golf lineup, seamlessly transitioning familiar basketball models onto the fairway.

Keeping the timeless look of the original basketball shoe intact, the new iteration arrives with a crisp white leather upper paired with a striking green patent leather mudguard. The carefully chosen shade of green perfectly mirrors the distinct color closely associated with Augusta National and the prestigious Masters Tournament.

On the performance side, the silhouette has been heavily modified for the green. Underneath, the low-top sneaker rests on a green-to-silver gradient plate that features seven strategically placed circular spikes to ensure premium traction throughout the golf course.

The Air Jordan 11 Low Golf "The Masters" drops in April 2027. Official pricing and retail channels remain TBA.

items.title: Maserati Celebrates a Century of their Legendary Trident at AutoClassica 2026
items.summary:
Summary 

Maserati celebrates 100 years of its Trident emblem at Milano AutoClassica 2026.A rare 1959 3500 GT Convertible Vignale Prototype is displayed alongside the new 490-hp GranCabrio.Historic motorsport icons also headline the showcase from November 19 to 22. 

Maserati is celebrating a century of its legendary Trident emblem by placing two of its iconic grand tourers side-by-side at Milano Auto Classica 2026. The showcase puts the ultra-rare 1959 Maserati 3500 GT Convertible Vignale Prototype next to the modern Maserati GranCabrio .

Built in Modena and unveiled at the 1959 Turin Motor Show, the 3500 GT Convertible Vignale Prototype is one of just six units ever produced. Designed by Carrozzeria Alfredo Vignale under Giovanni Michelotti, the drop-top established the blueprint for Maserati’s modern convertible grand tourers. Having been meticulously restored over the past three years, the silver-bodied classic retains its original 235-hp, 3.5-liter inline-six engine and a striking ivory, red, and gold interior inspired by the Vignale emblem.

Placed beside its predecessor, the contemporary Maserati GranCabrio demonstrates the evolution of their design language. Finished in Blu Emozione over a Greige leather and carbon-fiber cabin, the latest iteration features a redesigned front end for improved downforce and a wider track. Under the hood, Maserati’s F1-derived 3.0-liter Twin Turbo V6 delivers 490 hp alongside a new Country driving mode.

Beyond the main booth, attendees can explore Maserati’s lineage in the main hall, with motorsport icons 6C34, the Tipo 61, and the…
items.t: Maserati Celebrates a Century of their Legendary Trident at AutoClassica 2026

items.title: Bottega Veneta Looks Homeward for Spring 2027 With "Colours of Venice"

For Spring 2027 , Creative Director Louise Trotter once again taps British photographer Chris Rhodes to lens “Colours of Venice,” a photo series that focuses on tactile, live-in study of light and surface instead of grand canal panoramas.

Rather than treating the city as a static backdrop, Rhodes weaves between intimate interiors and open streets. Pink-plastered walls, intricate terrazzo flooring, rich damask fabrics, and gilded mirrors add textural depth to the clothing. Held close to the surroundings, the garments’ construction and saturated tones are highlighted through the use of natural light, creating a visual dialogue between Venice’s weathered surfaces and Trotter’s contemporary tailoring.

Leather goods remain the anchor of the seasonal narrative. Alongside the signature Cabat tote, Spring 2027 introduces the Verde, a new handbag that channels the laid-back ease of 1970s designs into a compact, architectural silhouette. items.title: Oris and Doraemon Travel Through Time on a Big Crown Pointer Date Watch
items.summary:
Summary 

Oris reimagines its Big Crown Pointer Date with Japanese manga icon Doraemon.A light blue dial, red minute track and yellow hands mirror the character.A flying Doraemon caseback engraving marks the 1,000-piece edition.

Oris is teaming up with one of Japan’s best-loved characters for its latest limited edition. The Swiss brand has released a Doraemon version of its signature Big Crown Pointer Date, inspired by the original manga by Fujiko F. Fujio, first published in 1970.

Conceived around a shared fascination with mechanics and time travel, the timepiece channels the cheerful aesthetic of the 22nd-century robotic cat into a wearable, subtle design. The idea came from Jo Haertel Yamaguchi, Sales Manager of Oris Japan, who drew inspiration from the brand’s earlier Kermit the Frog edition and grew up reading the manga in the 1980s. “I don’t think we’ve ever seen a Doraemon watch as charming as this,” he said in an interview included with the release.

The design keeps the references subtle. Housed in a 40mm multi-piece stainless steel case, this special timepiece features a vertically brushed light blue dial that matches Doraemon’s body color, while the red minute track picks up the color of his signature collar. The central seconds hand and the tip of the pointer date hand are yellow, a nod to the HOPTER, the propeller gadget Doraemon pulls from his 4D pocket so he can fly.

Flipping the watch over reveals a caseback engraved with Doraemon in flight, a fitting touch given the Big Crown’s aviation roots, along with each watch’s limited-edition number. The fun…
items.t: Oris and Doraemon Travel Through Time on a Big Crown Pointer Date Watch

items.title: Rihanna's 'Talk That Talk' Achieves Quadruple-Platinum Status on Its 15th Anniversary
items.summary:
Summary 

Rihanna's 2011 studio album Talk That Talk has officially reached quadruple-platinum status according to the RIAAStandout singles from the project including Where Have You Been and You Da One also received new multi-platinum certificationsA$AP Rocky recently teased that the superstar is currently back in the studio working on highly anticipated new music

Rihanna continues to prove her immense staying power on the charts as her 2011 album, Talk That Talk , officially reaches quadruple-platinum status. Arriving alongside the project's 15th anniversary, the RIAA database confirms that the superstar's sixth studio effort and several of its standout singles have earned new multi-platinum certifications.

Leading the pack of newly certified tracks is the hit single "Where Have You Been," which successfully climbed to 6x Platinum. Additionally, "You Da One" reached 4x Platinum, while the JAY-Z-assisted title track earned double-platinum status. The accolades arrive as Rihanna continues to break records without having released a full studio album since 2016's ANTI . According to reports, she recently became the first female musician to accumulate 200 million RIAA singles units, further widening her lead for the most Diamond singles by any woman. ANTI itself remains a dominant force, tallying over 508 weeks on the Billboard 200—a historical benchmark among Black female artists.

Despite early reports indicating that her next album would feature a reggae sound, Rihanna previously revealed she scrapped those plans to avoid genre limitations and protect the standard of her…
items.t: Rihanna's 'Talk That Talk' Achieves Quadruple-Platinum Status on Its 15th Anniversary

Summary 

Aston Martin will debut the Dreadnought at the 2027 Dakar Rally.The Dreadnought is a vehicle adapted from the video game 'Call of Duty'.The all-star driver lineup includes champions Alonso, Loeb, and Moraes.

Aston Martin is officially trading the pristine tarmac of Formula 1 for the unforgiving dunes of the Sahara. Aston Martin Racing will be making its debut at the 2027 Dakar Rally . Partnering with motorsport powerhouse Prodrive , Aston Martin is preparing to enter three Dreadnought competition vehicles, driven by a star-studded roster.

The vehicle they’re entering is one of the most unique in the brand’s century-long history: the Aston Martin Dreadnought. Originally conceived for the video game Call of Duty : Modern Warfare 4 , the Dreadnought has been transformed from pixels into a purpose-built rally raider. Engineered to master grueling distances, brutal terrain, and extreme heat, the Dreadnought represents a significant contrast, both aesthetically and mechanically, from Aston Martin’s traditional sleek grand tourers.

To tame these bespoke machines, Aston Martin has assembled a star-studded roster. Leading the lineup is two-time Formula 1 World Champion Fernando Alonso, who will take on the Dakar rally in addition to the F1 calendar. Alonso, who previously competed in the 2020 Dakar, will be reunited with five-time Dakar motorcycle champion Marc Coma as his co-driver. Joining him in the second Dreadnought is nine-time World Rally Championship icon Sébastien Loeb alongside co-driver Fabian Lurquin, hoping to finally secure a long-sought victory. Rounding…

items.title: H. Moser & Cie. Unveils the Water-Resistant Pioneer Tourbillon “Arctic Fizz” Limited Edition
items.summary:
Summary 

H. Moser & Cie. drops the 100-piece Pioneer Tourbillon Arctic Fizz in 40mm titanium.Features a frosted Arctic Blue fumé dial, rotating bezel, and 120-meter water resistance.Powered by the automatic double-hairspring HMC 805 calibre, priced around $65,950 USD.

H. Moser & Cie. is taking the tourbillon out of the boardroom and into the water. With the Pioneer Tourbillon Arctic Fizz, this new limited-edition model joins the Pioneer collection, which is Moser’s toughest line and one built to handle both city life and time in the water. This new iteration adds a rotating dive-style bezel, a titanium case and a matching titanium bracelet, aiming for a sporty, lightweight build. Its biggest technical highlight is its ability to handle up to 120 meters of water resistance, which is rarely seen on a watch housing such a delicate complication.

The dial is where the “fizz” comes in. Moser’s signature fumé gradient appears here in Arctic Blue, brighter at the center and darkening toward the edges, while a frosted texture gives the surface a sparkling, almost carbonated look as it catches the light. Applied faceted indices with Super-LumiNova dots and leaf-shaped hands filled with lume keep it readable in low light, and there’s no branding clutter to break up the gradient. At 6 o’clock sits a one-minute flying tourbillon under a skeletonized bridge, regulated by Moser’s own double hairspring.

The 40mm titanium case is 11.4mm thick, including its domed sapphire crystal and has a screw-down crown engraved with an “M” and a unidirectional rotating bezel. Through the sapphire…

items.title: ‘Physical: Asia’ Season 2 Is Officially Happening, and It’s Building an Entirely New World
items.summary:
Summary 

Netflix confirms Physical: Asia Season 2 will premiere in 2027.The season promises culture-inspired quests and nation-versus-nation matchups.The unscripted athletic survival franchise continues its rapid global expansion.

Netflix has confirmed that Physical: Asia will return for a second season in 2027, bringing back the competition in which Asian nations battle for national pride.

The series first premiered in October 2025 as the franchise’s first international team format, moving the action from individual athletes to national squads taking on large-scale quests inspired by Asian cultures. That combination of grit, teamwork and sportsmanship helped the Physical brand extend its streak in Netflix’s Global Top 10 to three consecutive seasons.

Producer Jang Ho-gi says the new season will not simply be a bigger version of the first. “For Season 2, we have designed an entirely different world from previous installments and developed quests capable of becoming new signatures for the Physical series,” he said, adding that the team plans to introduce new strategies, matchups and surprise results that only a nation-versus-nation format can produce.

The renewal is the latest sign of how far the franchise has traveled since Physical: 100 debuted in South Korea in early 2023. Local adaptations Physical: 100: Mexico and Physical: 100: Italy each held a spot in the Global Top 10 for two straight weeks, the Mexican edition has already been renewed for a second season, and U.S., French and Swedish versions are in development.

Kihwan Yoo, Director of Content at Netflix…

items.title: Van Gogh's "Blossoming Chestnut Trees" Sells for $190.4 Million USD, Becoming the Fourth Priciest Auction Sale Ever
items.summary:
Summary 

Vincent van Gogh’s 1890 masterpiece has achieved a staggering $190.4 million at a recent Sotheby's auction in ManhattanThe monumental transaction not only sets a new record for the artist but also ranks as the fourth most expensive art sale in auction historyThe historic sale successfully proceeded after a confidential eleventh-hour settlement regarding a Nazi-era ownership dispute

Sotheby's has officially overseen the historic $190.4 million sale of Vincent van Gogh 's "Châtaigniers en Fleurs (Blossoming Chestnut Trees)." The monumental Manhattan transaction establishes a massive new auction record for the legendary artist and officially cements the masterpiece as the fourth priciest sale ever recorded in auction history.

"Blossoming Chestnut Trees" offers a poignant glimpse into the final chapter of the artist's life. The record-breaking 1890 canvas beautifully depicts the serene French village of Auvers, capturing the light-dappled pastoral setting where van Gogh spent his final months before his death. The luminous scene of a large chestnut tree blooming in the evening light stands as a profound testament to his late-stage creative output, ultimately becoming the crown jewel of the Blaquier-Arrieta collection.

The historic sale arrived with intense eleventh-hour drama, proceeding only after a confidential settlement was reached regarding an ownership dispute tied to Nazi persecution in the 1930s. Defying a cautious high-end art market, the piece was ultimately acquired by veteran art dealer William Acquavella, securing its unprecedented final price tag and…
items.t: Van Gogh's "Blossoming Chestnut Trees" Sells for $190.4 Million USD, Becoming the Fourth Priciest Auction Sale Ever

Inside the special edition case, recipients will find a custom PlayStation 5 console alongside its controllers. To complete the ultimate travel gaming suite, the set also includes the GTA VI game itself.

While the collaboration successfully translates the fictional destination of Vice City into a tangible accessory, the release remains strictly exclusive. The collaborative effort has been produced entirely as a Friends & Family edition, intended to celebrate the game's launch among a select few.

As a Friends & Family exclusive, the RIMOWA x Rockstar Games Grand Theft Auto VI case will not be available for public retail.

items.title: A Coyote-Powered 1969 Ford Bronco Has Been Auctioned
items.summary:
Summary 

A fully customized 1969 Ford Bronco is currently up for auction via dealer consignmentThe classic truck is powered by a modern 5.0-liter Coyote V8 engine rated at 420 horsepowerThe extensive build features a lifted suspension with Fox shocks alongside four-wheel disc brakes and a bespoke interior

Ford 's iconic off-roader gets a massive modern upgrade in this custom 1969 Ford Bronco , which is currently up for auction at Bring A Trailer . Completed over a nine-year build process between 2013 and 2022, the vintage 4x4 masterfully blends classic American truck aesthetics with contemporary performance hardware and off-road capability.

Under the hood, the restomod replaces its original powertrain with a modern 5.0-liter Coyote crate V8 sourced from Summit Racing, pushing out an impressive 420 horsepower. The engine is mated to a Blumenthal five-speed manual transmission and an Atlas 3.0:1 Highlander dual-range transfer case. Delivering power to the ground, the Bronco sits on a lifted suspension system equipped with front Pro Comp coil springs, a rear multi-link coilover conversion utilizing Fox shocks, and a Currie Antirock sway bar. Stopping power is handled by four-wheel disc brakes featuring an Explorer-style rear setup and a hydroboosted Wilwood master cylinder.

Aesthetically, the body was repaired and refinished in a sleek gloss black, contrasting heavily with a removable white hardtop, white bumpers, and white 17-inch smoothie-style wheels wrapped in BFGoodrich All-Terrain T/A KO2 tires. Rugged exterior additions include a Warn winch, flush-fit hood pins,…

items.title: The Long Game: How Robert Pattinson Built the Perfect Resume for James Bond
items.summary:
Robert Pattinson ’s ascension to the role of James Bond is not just a major casting announcement—it is the culmination of one of the most calculated and successful career reinventions in modern Hollywood history. After officially being tapped by Amazon-MGM as the seventh actor to don the iconic tuxedo, the 40-year-old British star is set to usher 007 into a highly anticipated new era.

The blueprint of Pattinson's career is a masterclass in defying expectations. After exploding into global superstardom as the brooding vampire Edward Cullen in the Twilight franchise, he fiercely refused to be boxed in as a standard-issue Hollywood heartthrob. Instead, he spent the better part of a decade retreating into the gritty, auteur-driven trenches of independent cinema. Through daring, transformative performances in the Safdie brothers’ breathless Good Time and Robert Eggers’ surreal, claustrophobic The Lighthouse , Pattinson stripped away his teen-idol sheen and rebuilt his reputation as a character actor of remarkable range and feral intensity.

Having secured his indie credibility, he executed a flawless pivot back to the blockbuster stage. As the angsty, detective-focused Bruce Wayne in Matt Reeves’ The Batman (2022), Pattinson proved he could anchor a massive global franchise without compromising his artistic edge. His recent winning streak—earning "Oscar-worthy" acclaim as a real-life TV host in Primetime , stealing scenes as the villainous Antinous in Christopher Nolan’s The Odyssey , and teaming up with Denis Villeneuve for Dune: Part Three —has solidified his status as a…

PGA Tour legend Tiger Woods is officially making his return to the green for the upcoming Hero World Challenge. Stepping back into the spotlight after a grueling two-year absence, the 15-time major champion announced Tuesday that he will compete in the 72-hole, no-cut tournament set to take place at the Albany Golf Club in New Providence, Bahamas.

The 50-year-old golf legend hosts the annual tournament, which directly benefits his TGR Foundation. Joining a 20-man field that now includes recent additions Gary Woodland and Rickie Fowler, Woods will take on the strenuous 72-hole event from December 3 to December 6, where players are strictly prohibited from using golf carts.

The impending December tee time marks Woods' first PGA Tour appearance since missing the cut at the 2024 Open Championship at Scotland's Royal Troon Golf Club. His extended time away from the sport was initially prompted by a ruptured Achilles tendon in his left leg ahead of the 2025 Masters, which forced him to miss the entire season. This was followed by a seventh back surgery in October 2025 to replace a disk in his lower back. Whether you want minimalist or heritage, waterproof or suede, our menswear expert has rounded up the most stylish pairs for every occasion and outfit

• The best men’s coats for autumn and winter

I haven’t always worn boots. For years I wrote them off – at 5ft 8in, I was convinced anything above the ankle would make my legs look shorter. Then I started wearing them with the right trousers – a straight leg that falls over the top – and realised I’d spent a decade getting winter wrong. All anyone sees is a smart pair of shoes that happens to keep your ankles warm.

Here’s the thing: boots needn’t be intimidating. They’re just the wintry version of the leather shoes you already own. A chelsea is your loafer – it goes with pretty much everything in your wardrobe and every event in your diary, Christmas parties included. A derby boot is laced up, a bit sturdier and just as happy with jeans. The chukka is your weekend trainer. And the chunky, rubber-soled ones? Just think of them as an umbrella for your feet.
